zero_to_60.source: Trusted road tests (Car and Driver first; Road & Track, MotorTrend or Edmunds where noted). Read Nov 14, 2026 through the pages listed per model. Show on the site with an info icon and the source.
zero_to_60.note: Independent test results, not Acura figures. Acura does not publish 0-60 times. caranddriver.com cannot be opened from Claude's browser, so Car and Driver numbers were read from Car and Driver articles republished on Yahoo, or from pages that report the test (named per entry; confirm those before publishing). Several tests are of earlier model years of the same generation and engine. Trims without a test are left empty.
integra: 1.5 L turbo, CVT (2023 Integra A-Spec): 7.1 sec, Car and Driver instrumented test, read in the Car and Driver article republished by Yahoo | https://autos.yahoo.com/tested-2023-acura-integra-demonstrates-130000005.html
1.5 L turbo, 6-speed manual (2023 Integra): 7.0 sec, Car and Driver instrumented test, same article | https://autos.yahoo.com/tested-2023-acura-integra-demonstrates-130000005.html
Type S (2026 Integra Type S): 5.8 sec, Edmunds test, read on edmunds.com | https://www.edmunds.com/car-news/long-term/2026-acura-integra-type-s-test.html
Type S (2025 Integra Type S): 5.1 sec, Car and Driver instrumented test, as reported by 0-60specs.com (not read at the source) | https://www.0-60specs.com/acura/integra-0-60-times
adx: AWD (2025 ADX A-Spec Advance AWD): 8.7 sec, Car and Driver instrumented test, as reported by the Detroit News reviewer's page and by Road & Track | https://henrypayne.com/?p=34684
rdx: SH-AWD (2022 RDX A-Spec Advance): 6.2 sec, Car and Driver instrumented test, as reported by 0-60specs.com (not read at the source) | https://www.0-60specs.com/acura/rdx-0-60-times
SH-AWD (2025 RDX A-Spec Advance): 6.7 sec, MotorTrend test, as reported by 0-60specs.com (not read at the source) | https://www.0-60specs.com/acura/rdx-0-60-times
